description: An iconic Silver Shadow in pristine condition, meticulously maintained by its enthusiast owner. The definitive symbol of arrival for weddings and elite events.
A rare Bentley S2 Continental in stunning ivory white. Turns heads wherever it goes. Perfect for weddings, fashion shoots, and editorial photography.
Enzo Ferrari called it the most beautiful car ever made. This Series 1 E-Type in British Racing Green is a masterpiece — ideal for intimate weddings and luxury photo shoots.
The most famous car in the world. This immaculate DB5 in classic Silver Birch has featured in three film productions and multiple luxury brand campaigns.
An open-top cabriolet from Mercedes' golden era. Champagne gold with cream leather interior — the perfect carriage for a summer wedding procession.
One of Ferrari's most elegant grand tourers. Rosso Corsa red with tan interior. Available for private events, product launches, and exclusive photo campaigns.
A genuine 356 Speedster — one of Porsche's most collectible models. Polo White with red interior. Unforgettable at any event, wedding, or automotive shoot.
The official state and wedding limousine of choice for decades. This DS420 in Westminster Blue offers unrivalled rear comfort and a grandeur few cars can match.
An iconic American muscle car in candy apple red. Perfect for bold wedding arrivals, car-themed photo shoots, and any occasion that calls for a little flair.
A spirited British roadster with open-air charm. The TR6 is a favourite for engagement shoots, anniversary celebrations, and intimate countryside weddings.
A classic British limousine with a fold-back rear roof — perfect for the wedding party to arrive in style. Ribbon dressing and floral decoration available on request.
A homologation special from Alfa Romeo's racing golden age. Light, nimble, and breathtakingly beautiful — a showstopper at fashion and automotive shoots.
